message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $1 050 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (latest quarterly report, Q2 2024)  
> • Redfin Data Center – “California Median Home Price” (2024)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – American Community Survey (ACS) 5‑Year Estimates, 2022–2024  

> **Why the difference?**  
> • The *median* is the middle value of all listings and is less affected by extremely high‑priced properties.  
> • The *average* (mean) is higher because a small number of very expensive homes (e.g., coastal luxury estates) pull the mean upward.  

If you need a more specific figure for a particular county or city, let me know!
